run_flask_app: run a flask web server to fix character annotation YAML config files for animated drawings
load_cfg_yaml: load a character config YAML file from disk and return the parsed dictionary
write_cfg_yaml: write a character config dictionary to a YAML file on disk
process_annotation_submission: process a POST request to parse skeleton joint data and save updated annotations
index_route_render: render the annotation fixer UI with the character texture image and config data
